changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_role ( user_role_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), role_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES role_master(role_id), site_id BIGINT NULL REFERENCES site_master(site_id), status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'ACTIVE', created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP );
